correctness.rationale: Multiplicity-four Apéry coordinates (a,b,c) obey the four Kunz inequalities. Apéry minimality, being within 3 of maximal Apéry value, and complete pair/intersection families imply rational generating function z^5(1+z+z^3)/((1-z)(1-z^5)) for exactly two children; triple intersections give one 3-child semigroup per genus g>=4 and one 4-child ordinary semigroup at g=3. Independently verified symbolic identity of pair rational functions and exhaustive genus 3..64 Kunz triples with genuinely computed minimal generators. The family classification supplies all-genus completeness, beyond finite checks.
